value.name: Consecrated Horned Crocodile
value.desc:
A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.
Majestic beasts are sometimes revered by human beings as the embodiment of a greater power, their visages turned to analogy to feed in reference to a person, feeding their ego. However, the majority of beasts that have absorbed the "greater power" were slain by the overwhelming nature of the power itself. Only a few among their number evolved new forms.

customize.name: Lucky Coin

However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 3</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, puts up to 1 card with the highest original Elemental Dice cost in your Hand at the bottom of your deck, then creates 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and adds it to your Hand.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 4</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, then</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>s up to 3</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>cards. For each of those cards</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>ed, heal the character on your team that has taken the most damage for 1 HP and increase their Max HP by 1.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) After you play or</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>a</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>card, heal the character on your team that has taken the most damage for 1 HP.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
Randomly <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> 1 card from your Hand with the highest original Cost and create 1 Elemental Die of your active character's Element. (Only 1 such card can be played per Round)

Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Discard</color>
Use Action Cards or Character Skill effects to Discard Action Cards from Hand or Deck.
